chapter_title: Chương 18: 0018【Mã Nguồn Huyền Thoại Chưa Bị Rò Rỉ?】

segments.title: Chương 18: 0018【Mã Nguồn Huyền Thoại Chưa Bị Rò Rỉ?】
segments.content:
When Bian Guanyue returned to the county town, the sky was already growing dark.

To her, the day's events were a bit bizarre.

It was the first time she learned that there were buses so run-down, where the conductor could argue with passengers for the entire trip.

It was the first time she learned that her hometown actually had a village so poor that the teacher there couldn't even get paid.

And her usually cheerful and funny deskmate was hiding such a painful past.

Those were all part of another world she had never come into contact with!

Walking into the pitch-black alley, Bian Guanyue clutched her laptop and proceeded cautiously. The streetlights here were broken and no one had repaired them. The short distance of a few dozen meters made her afraid every time she came home at night.

Finally running to the front of her building, Bian Guanyue hurried upstairs and hesitated for a moment at her front door.

She also wanted to live peacefully with her mother.

But they always ended up arguing. She was afraid of another fight upon returning home.

Bian Guanyue thought to herself: Chen Guiliang surely doesn't have similar worries. He's not afraid of anything, not afraid of difficulties. How brave.

After standing at the door for a while, Bian Guanyue carefully took out her key.

The moment she pushed the door open a crack, her maternal grandmother walked over, ecstatic, "Guanguan, you're finally back!"

Bian Guanyue had already called to say she was safe while on the bus back from the city.

"Where is she?" Bian Guanyue scanned the room.

Her maternal grandfather stood in the living room and said, "Your mom went to stay at a hotel. She's heading back to Pengcheng tomorrow. The food is still warm, we were just waiting for you."

Bian Guanyue let out a long sigh of relief.

The three of them ate around the table. Her grandfather and grandmother occasionally put food on her plate.

Her grandfather asked, "Is the laptop fixed?"

Bian Guanyue said, "The replacement screen needs to be shipped from Pengcheng. The shop owner isn't sure about the time. He'll contact me when the new screen arrives."

"Did you go by yourself?" her grandmother asked.

"A classmate went with me," Bian Guanyue said, then added, "a female classmate."

A female classmate named Chen Guiniang.

Her grandparents exchanged a look.

They knew their granddaughter's micro-expressions when she was lying.

It was definitely a male classmate. To accompany their granddaughter to get her laptop fixed, he had missed the entire afternoon of classes.

Her grandfather pretended to know nothing. "I used to go to the city often when I was young, too. Where did you guys get the computer fixed?"

"Red Star Department Store," Bian Guanyue said.

Her grandfather reminisced, "That used to be the city center, the most bustling place in all of Longdu. After your grandmother and I made our relationship official, we even took a special bus trip to browse the Red Star Department Store. In the department store, your grandmother bought me a pair of pants, which I patched up and wore for more than ten years."

Bian Guanyue smiled. "You two were quite romantic when you were young."

"What's so romantic about it," her grandmother started to tear down his story. "When your grandfather was young, he was just a bit taller and a bit more handsome. Can good looks put food on the table? His salary was even a grade lower than mine. I was ignorant back then, possessed by some ghost to fall for him."

Her grandfather, however, boasted, "If you didn't fall for me, plenty of others would. A lot of the female comrades at the factory liked me. I'd get seven or eight matchmaking offers throughout the year. Your grandmother was panicking back then. She secretly wrote me a love letter and even copied a Soviet poem, insisting she wrote it herself."

"Who wrote you a love letter? I certainly didn't. Are you getting senile, your memory all mixed up?" her grandmother flatly denied.

Her grandfather argued, "You're the one who wrote it, and you won't admit it. The letter is in the cabinet. Do you want me to get it so we can check?"

The old couple bickered around the dinner table, and Bian Guanyue listened with a radiant smile.

The atmosphere gradually grew warm and cozy.

After dinner, and after watching a few minutes of TV with her grandparents, Bian Guanyue went back to her bedroom to do her homework.

In the living room, her grandfather turned down the TV volume to avoid disturbing his granddaughter's studies.

"Is Guanguan in a relationship?"

"How could that be? She just transferred here a week ago."

"Something feels off."

"Let's just observe. Even if she is seeing someone, don't you go saying anything rash and scare her."

"I'm not an idiot."

"..."

Bian Guanyue took out her practice sheets from her schoolbag and began to do her problems, carefully consulting her textbook.

"Where did the kite in the sky go? In a blink, it was gone. Who cut its string? Do you know..."

Her phone rang.

Bian Guanyue answered the call, "Hello."

"This is Qin Shi Huang." The voice was serious and deep.

What kind of nonsense is this?

Bian Guanyue recognized it was Chen Guiliang and was torn between laughter and tears.

Although she didn't know the "wire me money" meme, she played along, "Isn't Qin Shi Huang dead?"

"I took an elixir of immortality and have just awakened from a slumber of over two thousand years. I need startup capital to open the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor. Once I retrieve the treasures inside, I can recruit soldiers and rebuild the Great Qin Empire. When that time comes, I will make you the Empress of Qin."

"Your Majesty Qin Shi Huang, what is your UnionPay card number?"

"I don't have an ID card, so the bank won't issue me a card."

Hearing this, Bian Guanyue almost burst out laughing. She quickly suppressed it and said, "Then how am I supposed to give you the money?"

"On Sunday, during evening self-study, put the money in your desk drawer. Remember, do not attract anyone's attention."

"If I give you the money, can you give me a receipt?"

"Forging receipts is illegal. Woman, please mind your character!"

"What if you take the money and don't acknowledge it?"

"I will give you a token. With this token, it is as if I, the Emperor, am present."

"Alright, I'll go withdraw the money tomorrow."

"See you this weekend!"

After saying this, Chen Guiliang hung up.

Bian Guanyue couldn't help but smile, murmuring to herself with a grin, "Silly goose!"

This deskmate of hers was so ridiculous, even his phone calls were crazy.

She suddenly didn't feel like doing her problems anymore. She lay her head on her desk and stared into space, recalling that crazy bus from earlier today.

After hanging up, Chen Guiliang sat on the sofa thinking for a while. "Cousin-in-law, can I borrow a pen and paper?"

"Get them from the study yourself." Feng Tao was taking care of the child.

This apartment was 118 square meters. The developer was quite honest, with almost no common area included in the floor space.

In the study, there was a large bookshelf filled with various books related to computers and the internet. There was also a computer that his cousin-in-law had built himself.

Pulling out a few sheets of A4 paper, Chen Guiliang planned to write something down.

He had neither capital nor technical skills, so he could only offer operational ideas and partner with someone. The first priority was to prevent the other party from kicking him to the curb after crossing the river, taking all the profits for themselves!

He could apply the "Dark Forest Theory"—if they dared to take everything for themselves, then no one would get to play.

He also had to pull his cousin-in-law in. If that Tao Chenggang decided to hog the profits or fudge the numbers during dividend distribution, it would mean offending his old friend, his cousin-in-law, as well.

Feng Tao played with the child for a while, then took a shower to get rid of the smell of alcohol, before coming to the study to see what Chen Guiliang was up to.

On the A4 paper was a list full of pay-to-win schemes!

"You want to put these into the private server?" Feng Tao asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "Yeah, these alone will make it a hit."

"Impossible," Feng Tao shook his head repeatedly. "If you rashly make large-scale modifications to the game, there will definitely be so many bugs it won't even run."

Chen Guiliang suspected it was due to his cousin-in-law's lack of skill. "It's just adding a few features."

Feng Tao gave an example, "There's this master named Le Jian who developed a feature to clear a player's red name. Even that had bugs when it first went online. You want to cram in so many features, which is much harder than clearing red names. It's a major technical challenge."

Chen Guiliang felt something was off. At this time, for a Legend private server, even adding a feature to clear red names required a master's intervention?

"With the source code, can't you just modify the game as you please?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Feng Tao, in turn, was very surprised. "You have the Legend source code?"

Chen Guiliang became even more confused. "Wasn't the Legend source code leaked last year?"

Feng Tao was speechless. "Who told you the Legend source code was leaked? What came out last year was just the server program from abroad. Right now, making a Legend private server relies on modifying the login client's IP."

Chen Guiliang: "..."

This was purely the media's fault. Chen Guiliang had been deceived for twenty years.

Of course, it could also have been false information intentionally released by Shanda, to paint themselves as a victim, gain public sympathy, and use it to fight with the Korean side for control of Legend.

Chen Guiliang asked again, "How do those domestic Legend private servers modify game features?"

Feng Tao explained, "Initially, it was done through reverse engineering to locate and modify the main binary program file. More than two months ago, a gaming group called CNE released a private server modification wizard, which made creating and modifying private servers much easier."

At this point, Feng Tao complained, "It's because of that modification wizard that Legend private servers are everywhere now. The competition is fierce, and it's not easy to make money, so I quit."

"Fuck!"

Chen Guiliang couldn't help but curse.

The leakage of the Legend source code happened later on.

The masterminds in the private server community, through repeated reverse engineering, eventually had the source code reproduced by Lingfeng Studio. Immediately, they were targeted by Shanda. When Lingfeng Studio was forced to disband, they retaliated by publicly releasing the Legend source code.

That was still a long way off from now.

Currently, changing or adding private server features was very difficult from a technical standpoint. Of course, one could also say it wasn't difficult, but it required a lot of time to grind it out.

This unexpected situation threw Chen Guiliang's plans into disarray.

Reincarnators weren't omniscient. A lot of public information was wrong from the very beginning.

He wanted to implement the pay-to-win schemes from browser games into a Legend private server to make a quick buck.

But the problem was, he couldn't implement them!

Things like a sign-in system, ranking system, or lottery system were very difficult to just cram into a private server.

What to do?

Chen Guiliang had even confidently declared he was going to talk business with Boss Tao. The meeting was already set, but what the hell was there to talk about now?

He had to change his way of thinking.
